interaction.action: Click the "Add to Bag" button for the first visible product

violation.help: After 'Add to Bag' is clicked, a bag item count appears/updates inside the header's Bag link (from absent to '1'), but axe-core reports the SAME violation count before and after — it does not detect this as a problem because it only evaluates static snapshots. The count is not wrapped in an ARIA live region, so a screen reader user who is not focused on the Bag link receives no notification that an item was added.
